events.title: U.S. Import Prices Jump More Than Expected In October
events.description: The Labor Department released a report on Tuesday showing an extended surge in U.S. import prices in the month of October.

events.title: U.S. Retail Sales Increase In Line With Estimates In October
events.description: A report released by the Commerce Department on Tuesday showed a modest increase in U.S. retail sales in the month of October.

events.title: Mixed Open Likely On Bay Street
events.description: Canadian stocks are seen opening on a mixed note Tuesday morning. Tech stocks will be in focus ahead of Nvidia's earnings announcement later in the day. Buying is likely in energy and materials sectors thanks to advancing oil and precious metals prices.

events.title: German Economic Confidence Improves: ZEW
events.description: German economic confidence improved in October driven by declining oil prices and increased government expenditure, survey data from the Mannheim-based Centre for European Economic Research, or ZEW, showed Tuesday. The ZEW indicator of economic sentiment rose more-than-expected to 35.6 in October from 28.1 in the previous month. The score was seen at 28.8.

events.title: Home Depot Q3 Profit, Comps Up; Cuts FY26 Adj. Margin View; Names New CEO, COO, CFO; Shares Drop
events.description: Home Depot, Inc., the world's largest home improvement retailer, reported Tuesday higher third-quarter profit and comparable sales, but weak adjusted operating margin. Further, the firm revised fiscal 2026 earnings and sales outlook, and trimmed adjusted margin view. Separately, Home Depot announced the appointment of current Chief Financial Officer Richard McPhail as chief executive officer.

events.title: FTSE 100 Drops 0.8% On AI Uncertainty, Mixed Labor Data
events.description: U.K. equities declined Tuesday as investors grew cautious over potential U.S. restrictions on Chinese AI chip access. The FTSE 100 dropped 89.60 points to 10,803.33. Miners and financial stocks led losses while unemployment fell to 4.6% in Q3.

events.title: Luxury Stocks Lead French Market Decline Amid Multiple Headwinds
events.description: French equities declined Tuesday amid U.S.-China AI chip restrictions, uncertainty over data center sustainability, and concerns about planned strikes in France. The CAC 40 fell 0.76%. Luxury stocks led losses, with Hermès down 4.7%.

events.title: Yen Rises Amid Fx Intervention Risks
events.description: The Japanese yen strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Tuesday, due to rumors that the Japanese government will intervene to support the country's currency.

events.title: German Stocks Decline On U.S. Chip Restrictions
events.description: German stocks declined Tuesday as the U.S. pursues tighter restrictions on China's advanced AI chip access. The DAX fell 0.9% to 26,390.85, with Deutsche Bank dropping 5.6%. Germany's economic sentiment improved, with the ZEW indicator reaching 35.6 in November.

events.title: UK Jobless Rate Falls; Job Vacancies Plunge
events.description: The UK unemployment rate declined unexpectedly in the third quarter while job vacancies fell notably and wage growth moderated, reflecting mixed inflationary pressures from labor market dynamics. The ILO unemployment rate fell to 4.6 percent from 4.7 percent in the prior period, data from the Office for National Statistics showed on Tuesday. The rate was forecast to remain stable at 4.7 percent.

events.title: Yen Rises Against Majors
events.description: The Japanese yen strengthened against other major currencies in the European session on Tuesday.

events.title: Indian Shares End Higher; IT Stocks Slip As Rupee Rises Further
events.description: Indian shares closed Tuesday's session higher despite weak cues from global markets and the headwinds of a stronger dollar and higher bond yields in international markets.

events.title: Gold Holds Near Fourteen-month Low
events.description: Gold prices hovered near a fourteen-month low on Tuesday, weighed down by the headwinds of a stronger dollar, higher Treasury yields and tech-led liquidations.
